verdict.rationale: Mistral has a dedicated 'Send your first API request' quickstart plus official Python/TypeScript SDKs installable via pip/npm, giving developers runnable code in their language to reach a first API call quickly. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on confirmation of the quickstart's actual time-to-first-call, no evidence of curl/other language examples beyond Python/TS, and no code snippet content shown in the evidence pack itself.
